gui.essentialcraft5.demon_standing.perk..en: Demons you summon ask two prices, and either one will do
gui.essentialcraft5.demon_standing.perk..zh: 你召出的恶魔开两样要价，交哪样都行

gui.essentialcraft5.demon_standing.perk..en: Every trade gives you %s extra experience
gui.essentialcraft5.demon_standing.perk..zh: 每做成一笔多给你 %s 点经验

gui.essentialcraft5.demon_standing.perk..en: Once per demon, sneak and right-click it holding a Captured Soul to hand over one soul for new prices
gui.essentialcraft5.demon_standing.perk..zh: 每只恶魔一次，潜行时手持被俘灵魂右键它，交出一个灵魂换一次要价

message.essentialcraft5.demon_standing.r.en: Your Demonic Renown has reached %2$s, and demons now treat you as a %1$s. %3$s.
message.essentialcraft5.demon_standing.r.zh: 契约之誉到了 %2$s，恶魔把你当成%1$s了。%3$s。

message.essentialcraft5.demon_standing.b.en: It takes the soul and names new prices.
This demon has already changed its prices once.
message.essentialcraft5.demon_standing.b.zh: 这只恶魔已经换过一次要价了。

gui.essentialcraft5.demon_trade.any_soul.en: They must all come from the same kind of creature; any kind will do
gui.essentialcraft5.demon_trade.any_soul.zh: 都要是同一种生物的灵魂，哪种生物都行

commands.essentialcraft5.demon_standing..zh: 已把 %s 的契约之誉设为 %s
